summary: URSB Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiary, United Roosevelt Savings Bank, appointed Raymond J. Vanaria, CPA, to the Bank's board effective October 28, 2026. The filing states that Lawrence B. Seidman, described as an investor in community banks, recommended Vanaria, a public accounting firm member who previously served on publicly traded community bank boards. No stake percentage, price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The appointment signals investor-driven board influence at the New Jersey thrift holding company, a recurring Seidman pattern. Watch for further board reconstitution, strategic review, or capital-return pressure.
